tagline: Standalone player that analyzes every song and removes the music automatically
changelog: Auto purify: every song is analyzed the moment you import it (real FFT, on device) and its music is removed automatically on playback — pure vocals with zero taps
Background batch analysis: the whole import is analyzed per song before the first note plays; “✓ auto” marks analyzed tracks
Clarity ring + live strategy card on the Now Playing screen
New professional identity: deep-ink UI with teal signal accents, gold details and a redesigned launcher icon
Still fully standalone: library, search, playlists, favorites, queue, 5-band EQ, sleep timer, WAV export — completely separate from the download website
